mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before consulting a contractor about a guest apartment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before scheduling a consultation, determine the primary intended use for the space. Will it accommodate aging parents, visiting relatives, or provide a long-term home for an adult child? If the space is meant for seniors, note accessibility requirements early, such as zero-threshold walk-in showers, wider doorways, and single-level layouts. Next, gather any existing home blueprints, locate your electrical breaker panel, and identify your outdoor water and sewer access points. Having a general budget in mind and a clear list of must-have features—such as kitchenettes, separate laundry hookups, or private exterior entrances—helps streamline the initial estimating process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Identify who will use the space, note accessibility needs like walk-in showers, locate your electrical panel and plumbing access, and outline your budget and preferred layout features.
